title.zh: 观察字母、数字和中文的分词
title.en: Observe how letters, digits and Chinese are tokenized

prompt.zh: 用 tiktoken 写五个观察用的小函数，在 GPT-2 的编码和较新的 o200k 编码上对比。测试覆盖五个现象，即同一个词带不带空格切法不同、把字母分开写后每个字母成为一个 token、数字被切成不规则的片段且多一位就错位、中文的 token 数因分词器而异、GPT-2 中一个汉字可能被切到不同的 token 里。
prompt.en: Write five small inspection functions with tiktoken and compare the GPT-2 encoding with the newer o200k encoding. The tests cover five phenomena, namely that a word is cut differently with and without a space, that letters written apart each become a token, that numbers are cut into irregular pieces that shift with one more digit, that the token count of Chinese depends on the tokenizer, and that in GPT-2 one Chinese character may be split across tokens.

hints.zh: `enc.decode_single_token_bytes(t)` 返回一个 token 的原始字节。这里用字节而不是字符串，是因为有些 token 单独解码不是合法的 UTF-8。
hints.en: `enc.decode_single_token_bytes(t)` returns the raw bytes of one token. Bytes are used here and not strings because some tokens alone are not valid UTF-8.

hints.zh: `digit_groups` 就是每个 token 的字节长度。数字都是单字节字符，所以字节数等于位数。
hints.en: `digit_groups` is the byte length of every token. Digits are single-byte characters, so the number of bytes equals the number of digits.

hints.zh: `letters_are_tokens` 比较的是 `spell_out(word)` 的 token 是否正好是每个字母前面加一个空格。
hints.en: `letters_are_tokens` checks whether the tokens of `spell_out(word)` are exactly each letter with a space in front.
